title: cdk-construct-dynamodb examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-dynamodb/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — hashKey only, PAY_PER_REQUEST billing
- provisioned/ — PROVISIONED billing with autoscaler (divergent: adds Application AutoScaling)
- with-gsi/ — global secondary indexes
- with-lsi/ — local secondary indexes
- with-range-key/ — composite primary key (hashKey + rangeKey)
- encrypted/ — KMS from bridge fixture (divergent: customer-managed key)
- with-replicas/ — replicaConfig for Global Tables (divergent: cross-region replication)

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/dynamodb-examples.test.ts.
